title: Generative AI and Its Impact on Personalized Intelligent Tutoring Systems
extended_summary:
This paper examines how generative AI, especially large language models such as GPT-4, can be integrated into intelligent tutoring systems (ITS) to support more personalized and adaptive learning. The paper is not an empirical evaluation; instead, it synthesizes recent literature and examples to describe how generative AI can enable automated question generation, personalized feedback, and interactive dialogue within tutoring systems.

The paper focuses on educational technology use cases rather than a specific learner sample or school-based intervention. It discusses how these capabilities could be used across subjects, including examples from biology, mathematics, and language learning, with the goal of tailoring instruction to individual learner needs in real time. The authors also outline major implementation challenges, including pedagogical accuracy, bias, equity, and sustained learner engagement.

The main conclusion is that generative AI has substantial potential to transform ITS by making them more dynamic, responsive, and engaging, but that realizing this potential will require safeguards such as validation, human oversight, and bias mitigation. The paper also argues that future ITS may benefit from multimodal AI and affective computing, alongside stronger ethical and policy frameworks for responsible deployment.
quality_tier_rationale: This is a narrative/position-style report rather than an empirical study. It synthesizes prior work and proposes applications, but does not present a clear experimental design, sample, or causal evaluation.
impact_tier_rationale: No measurable learner or system impact is reported in this paper. The article discusses potential benefits and challenges, but provides no effect sizes or outcome data to support impact claims.

interventions.use_case: A conceptual overview of generative AI/LLM integration into intelligent tutoring systems for personalized question generation, real-time feedback, and interactive tutoring dialogue.
LLM-generated personalized feedback, hints, and corrective explanations tailored to learner errors and misconceptions within an ITS.
Adaptive learning pathways and personalized content pacing driven by generative AI to match learner responses and proficiency.
